sources.note: Main product page for summitEHR. Describes core features: smart templates, voice-enabled charting, scheduling, telehealth, secure messaging, e-prescribing, analytics, and interoperability. Joint product of Summus Health Care and DataQ Health.

ONC certification and mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, notes NewCrop (e-prescribing) and EMR Direct (messaging) integrations, OAuth 2.0 authentication. States no extra charges for ONC-related features. 13 clinical quality measures tested.

DataQ Health corporate site. Focuses on 360 Platform (DeepLearn, CareManager, Ribbon, PopulationBuilder) and value-based care/MIPS services. Reports 15,000 providers, 3,000 practices, $295M shared savings. No direct mention of summitEHR on this page.

DataQ Health about page. Founded 2020 by Dr. R. Haris Naseem (cardiac electrophysiologist). Acquired Wiseman Innovations in 2023. Leadership team: CEO Dr. Naseem, CFO Julie Do, CTO Bilal Aslam, SVP Matt Beresford, VP Clinical Merena Tindall.
Press release about DataQ Health acquiring Wiseman Innovations LLC. Combined data analytics and clinical services capabilities. Maintained Dallas, TX headquarters.

DataQ Health care management services page. Describes coordinated care, patient transitions, individualized care plans. Reports 15% HbA1c reduction, 27% ER visit reduction outcomes. References 360 Platform integration.
DataQ Health MIPS reporting services page. Offers MIPS solutions, tools, advanced support, medical record extractions, and security services.

Summus Healthcare corporate site. North Texas healthcare management organization operating 35+ providers through Premier Independent Physicians, North Texas Diabetes & Endocrinology, Premier Care Behavioral Health, and Starwood Pharmacy. 200% average annual growth. Co-developer of summitEHR.
